question: What are the key catalysts for Diginex?

beats.line: Diginex faces a run of execution milestones. They decide whether the platform consolidation thesis gains traction or stalls.
beats.headline: EXECUTION MILESTONES
beats.action: [0-5s] A large halftone calendar page lands on open ground and stacked sheets slide in beneath it. [5-10s] The sheets fan out into a row of milestone markers, then settle as the calendar page holds centre.
beats.delivery: [presenting to camera] Diginex faces a run of execution milestones. They decide whether the platform consolidation thesis gains traction or stalls.

beats.line: Updates on the unified strategy come in the second quarter of twenty twenty-six. That's the critical near-term catalyst.
beats.headline: Q2 2026
beats.action: [0-5s] The previous headline chip slides off the top edge as the calendar page turns to a fresh sheet and a paper hand brings a rubber stamp down onto it. [5-10s] Cut to the stamped mark close in, ink spreading, the calendar page framed behind it.
beats.delivery: Updates on the unified strategy come in the second quarter of twenty twenty-six. That's the critical near-term catalyst.

beats.line: Investors want evidence the four acquired businesses are operationally unified, not run as silos.
beats.headline: 4 BUSINESSES
beats.action: [0-5s] The previous chip flips away as the stamped page tears into four separate paper blocks standing apart on cyan ground. [5-10s] String and pins run between the four blocks, pulling them into one tied cluster.
beats.delivery: Investors want evidence the four acquired businesses are operationally unified, not run as silos.

beats.line: The one point five billion dollar Resulticks deal is the transformative bet. Cross-sell is the test.
beats.headline: $1.5B
beats.action: [0-5s] The previous chip drops out as the tied cluster contracts and one large paper block rises above the others. [5-10s] Stencilled arrows cross back and forth between the large block and the cluster, then hold.
beats.delivery: The one point five billion dollar Resulticks deal is the transformative bet. Cross-sell is the test.

beats.line: Without cross-sell evidence, the acquisition becomes a financial burden rather than a strategic unlock.
beats.headline: BURDEN OR UNLOCK
beats.action: [0-5s] The previous chip slides right as a paper hand presses down on the large paper block and torn strips buckle beneath it. [5-10s] The hand lifts, the strips spring back, and the large paper block settles level again.
beats.delivery: Without cross-sell evidence, the acquisition becomes a financial burden rather than a strategic unlock.

beats.line: Revenue grew two hundred and ninety-three percent year on year, to two million dollars, driven mainly by subscription.
beats.headline: +293% YOY
beats.action: [0-5s] The previous chip flips down as the large paper block splits into a paper bar chart climbing left to right on lime ground. [5-10s] A torn-paper arrow rises along the bars and stops at the tallest one.
beats.delivery: [excited] Revenue grew two hundred and ninety-three percent year on year, to two million dollars, driven mainly by subscription.

beats.line: October's warrant exercise generated thirteen point eight million dollars, strengthening net assets above ten point nine million.
beats.headline: +$13.8M
beats.action: [0-5s] The previous chip slides off as the torn-paper arrow folds down into a stack of paper coins that grows coin by coin. [5-10s] Cut in close on the coin stack as two final coins settle on top.
beats.delivery: October's warrant exercise generated thirteen point eight million dollars, strengthening net assets above ten point nine million.

beats.line: If the second quarter update shows integration delays or weaker cross-sell, downside risk remains material.
beats.headline: DOWNSIDE RISK
beats.action: [0-5s] The previous chip is covered as the ground turns magenta and the coin stack sits on grid paper. [5-10s] A torn-paper arrow enters above the coin stack and swings down to point below the grid line.
beats.delivery: If the second quarter update shows integration delays or weaker cross-sell, downside risk remains material.

beats.line: At a thirty-four million dollar market cap, Diginex is priced for significant scepticism.
beats.headline: $34M MKT CAP
beats.action: [0-5s] The previous chip flips away as the downward arrow shrinks into one small paper block alone on open grid paper. [5-10s] The grid paper widens around the small paper block, leaving it isolated at centre.
beats.delivery: At a thirty-four million dollar market cap, Diginex is priced for significant scepticism.

beats.line: Credible traction could re-rate the stock sharply. The next six to nine months are make-or-break.
beats.headline: 6-9 MONTHS
beats.action: [0-5s] The previous chip drops as the small paper block unfolds back into the calendar page on violet ground. [5-10s] A paper hand slides a torn-paper arrow across the calendar page and pins it there, the page holding centre.
beats.delivery: Credible traction could re-rate the stock sharply. The next six to nine months are make-or-break.
